answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, and let established peers vouch only by risking part of their own stake. A new identity starts with a low trading limit and gains it slowly as completed jobs are verified. Creating many fake identities then means funding every one, while detected fraud burns the stake and the vouchers' collateral. Like a pearl formed layer by layer, trust accumulates slowly; a relic of past verified work cannot be copied cheaply, and a plume of sudden new identities stands out for review before any large payment is released.
